TITLE:
Haryana CM Urges Power Staff to End 3-Day Strike Over Private Discom Licence

DESCRIPTION:
Haryana Chief Minister calls on 40,000 power staff to cancel a 3‑day strike over a private discom licence, which caused over 16 hours of outages, dark homes, dry taps, idle factories and road protests in Gurgaon. #Haryana #PowerStrike #PrivateDiscom #Gurgaon

Source: https://news.google.?oc=5
